brief:
# 单机三成员真实验收

One computer; one human; three project identities; real existing Codex account and one SciencePAL account. Controlled process exit, question and pilot refinement; not cross-account or OS sandbox isolation.

一个队长、两个成员。SciencePAL 官方 Biology Agent 执行真实 1CRN 表面积计算，成员 Codex 汇总，队长 Codex 独立复核。

本次主动注入连接器进程退出，并预先安排等待输入与低精度先导退回。没有伪造科研输出，也没有修改电脑网络。只验证应用身份与工作目录隔离，不证明不同 SciencePAL 账号或 OS 用户隔离。

在交接节点可查看真实输入回执；在科学检查中可查看总面积与逐残基求和、残基数量的检查。在阶段间不会提前显示未来的批准或文件交接。

验收报告包含权限 HTTP 403、原线程恢复和远端提交次数；离线核验命令：npm run test:isolated-acceptance。
guide:
# 第一次接入：只做这三步

这是多人各用自己的 Agent、由队长统一发布和评审的科研工作区。SciencePAL 成员负责专业科研执行，Codex 成员可以独立复算、整理代码与分析结果；每个人只需准备自己使用的平台。

## 先拿到同一版本

[下载当前源码 ZIP](https://github.com/WeihanChen000/vibe-git-research/archive/refs/heads/codex/research-team-share.zip)，解压后进入其中的 `vibe-git` 子目录。电脑需要 Node.js 24+；首次打开会自动安装依赖和构建，请保留终端。不要在 ZIP 压缩预览中直接运行。

- **我是队长，房间还没开**：双击 `open-captain.cmd`。
- **我是收到邀请的队友**：双击 `open-research.cmd`。不用自己开 Host。
- **只想了解作品**：[直接看视频](https://weihanchen000.github.io/vibe-git-research/submission/watch.html)，无需安装或账号。

## ① 加入房间

队友把队长发来的邀请粘贴到本机页面。跨电脑邀请必须是队长配置的 HTTPS 地址；`localhost`、`127.0.0.1` 只能在同一台电脑演练。不要把浏览器地址栏中的本人登录链接当邀请。队长本人的身份自动接入，无需再加入自己。

## ② 绑定自己的 Agent

在顶部“接入算力网”选择平台：

- **SciencePAL**：填写本人 Key → 验证账号并读取 Agent → 选本人可用的科研专家 → 接入算力网。浏览器已登录 SciencePAL 不等于连接器已获得 API 权限。Key 只存在本人电脑，不发给队长。
- **Codex**：选择 Codex 本地执行 → 接入算力网。后续领取任务时启动已安装并登录的 Codex；也可以复制任务说明交给自己的 Codex，完成后在同一待办交回文件。

## ③ 保存提案，然后跟着“现在轮到谁”

写清研究问题、数据、本人分工、方法、单位和验收标准，点“保存我的提案”。成员保存后等待队长；队长从左上角 `vibe-git` 打开“科研项目”，选成员、上传共同数据、建立项目，再按待办对齐与发布。1CRN / Iris 只是可选示例。

| 看到什么 | 下一步 |
|---|---|
| 等待本人执行 / 评审 | 打开“现在轮到谁”；SciencePAL 启动本人连接器，Codex 准备任务包并启动本人 Agent |
| 评审退回 | 队长查看具体修改项并安排返工，作者处理新的尝试，旧文件保留 |
| 结果不变、仅缺证据 | 队长从“现在轮到谁”提交“补充证据复审”，写清来源；原成果不重算，仍由独立评审者判断 |
| 数值检查失败 | 作者按失败项修正，队长确认重试；评审写“通过”不能跳过已冻结的检查 |
| 等待本人回答 | 在 SciencePAL 原线程回答，保持本人连接器运行；回到本页看同一线程是否接续 |
| 已完成 | 查看结论、原始成果、独立评审和文件交接记录 |

本机入口在线不代表模型正在执行。只有配置的数值检查通过、独立评审通过且交接依据齐全，成果才可供下游使用。没有配置的检查不等于已经核验。

跨电脑房间配置、已有房间重开、升级和故障处理见下方“完整接入说明”。真实执行使用各自账号额度；本项目尚未完成两位真人各自账号的联合验收。

## 暂时找不到队友

可以先做[单机多成员验收](https://github.com/WeihanChen000/vibe-git-research/blob/codex/research-team-share/vibe-git/SCIENCEPAL-ISOLATED-ACCEPTANCE.md)：[已有记录可以直接回放](https://weihanchen000.github.io/vibe-git-research/replay/?case=isolated&step=members)；`npm run research:acceptance -- --live` 使用现有 Codex 和一个 SciencePAL 账号，验证真实返工、等待输入与连接器恢复。不会把它标成真人跨账号验证。

proposals.content:
# Preregistered single-machine three-member acceptance
Real public 1CRN structure, chain A, heavy ATOM records only, alternate location blank/A, no HETATM or hydrogens, Angstrom. Exact source attachment; do not refetch. This is computational geometry, not functional or clinical evidence.
Exactly TWO tasks: sasa assigned to the SciencePAL member, synthesis assigned to the non-captain Codex member. Captain coordinates alignment and independently reviews both tasks; captain has no authoring task. Use member-scoped IDs from context, never merge the two Codex members.
SciencePAL sasa MUST actually run Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley, probe_radius_A=1.4, radii C=1.70 N=1.55 O=1.52 S=1.80. Deliver total_A2 and residues [{residue_id:integer,area_A2:number}], n_points, atom_count, residue_count, source_sha256, method literal Shrake-Rupley, code (complete portable executed Python source) and tool_versions. All values must be computed, not copied from earlier studies.
FIRST sasa attempt is a deliberately incomplete PILOT: BEFORE computing, use your actual ask-user/question tool to ask for the verification phrase. The required answer is not in these files; wait, do not invent one. This is an authorized controlled NEEDS_INPUT lifecycle test. Once an answer arrives, compute ONLY n_points=100, label exploratory, and submit. It intentionally FAILS the final acceptance requirement; reviewer must request_changes. On REWORK (when previous-sasa.json and feedback are provided), do not ask again: compute 1000 and 5000 points, report convergence total relative difference <=2% and limitation. This is planned refinement, not an accidental model mistake.
Sasa acceptance must include: correct frozen source/filter/counts; actual code and tool versions with units/radii; final n_points>=1000 AND an actually executed 5000-point comparison with <=2% total difference. Retain pilot truthfully; no fabricating success. Codex reviewer must compute an independent baseline using actual source and standard Python or available NumPy, and report numeric evidence in reproduction. For pilot, a correct 100-point output still requires changes because precision criterion is unmet.
Synthesis reads only APPROVED sasa.json and source, independently sums residues and hashes approved upstream bytes, and emits summary, total_A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256, code. Explicitly say single fixed structure, no biological function ranking. Captain independently reviews synthesis by recomputing counts/sums/hashes.
Only use available tools; no package installs or network refetch. For local Windows Python use python or py if available; do not scan unrelated paths. All public evidence must avoid user paths, tokens, personal contact details. Code should use relative input paths. Stop after actual required envelope exists.

ROLE: Captain: align and independently review, do not author sasa/synthesis

tasks.title: Compute and refine frozen 1CRN SASA
tasks.goal: Execute Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley on the frozen filtered chain A through the controlled exploratory pilot and rework lifecycle. Deliver sasa.json with source_sha256, method literal Shrake-Rupley, probe_radius_A, n_points, total_A2, atom_count, residue_count, residues [{residue_id:integer,area_A2:number}], complete executed code and tool_versions, matching the exact sasa resultSchema reproduced in alignmentMarkdown; include truthful pilot, convergence and limitation evidence in schema-permitted fields.
tasks.boundary: Assigned only to the SciencePAL member; captain independently reviews. Single frozen structure, computational geometry only. Do not bypass the required first-attempt question, install packages, refetch source, author synthesis, invent verification text, copy historical SASA values, or claim the pilot meets final acceptance. Rework requires previous-sasa.json and feedback; no repeat question.
acceptance: Read and hash the exact frozen source-1CRN.pdb; source_sha256 must equal 42199a30a0701864a2a5cc76cd7f35cc544cd0e65fbcf63e03c166543249b811. Apply chain A, heavy ATOM, alternate location blank/A, no HETATM/hydrogen filters; independently confirm atom_count=327, residue_count=46, and unique residue_id values 1..46.

Actually execute Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley with probe_radius_A=1.4 and radii C=1.70, N=1.55, O=1.52, S=1.80 Angstrom; method must be Shrake-Rupley; total_A2 and per-residue area_A2 are computed square-Angstrom values, not copied references.

On FIRST attempt, before SASA computation use an actual ask-user/question tool to request the verification phrase and wait for a real answer in NEEDS_INPUT. After receiving it, execute ONLY n_points=100, label exploratory, submit the truthful deliberately incomplete pilot, and receive request_changes; missing tool/answer must be reported without invention.

On REWORK with previous-sasa.json and feedback, do not ask again; actually run n_points=1000 and 5000. Deliver final n_points>=1000, both measured totals, abs(total_1000-total_5000)/abs(total_5000)<=0.02 with denominator stated, consistent top-level resolution, retained pilot evidence and a numerical/structural limitation. A missing comparison or 100-point-only output fails final acceptance.

Deliver every required field with exact types under the unchanged sasa schema: 46 residue objects, integer residue_id, nonnegative numeric area_A2 and total_A2, integer n_points, complete portable actually executed Python code and actual tool_versions; include units, radii, run settings and execution evidence. Use relative paths and no sensitive public details.

Pass frozen scientificChecks version 1: abs(total_A2-sum(residues[*].area_A2))<=0.001 A2 and residue_count=46 exactly. Schema validity, execution success, these checks and scientific approval must be distinguished; do not alter observations or frozen rules to force a pass.

Captain reviewerAgentId=member_node-4050b257-1656-4536-aaff-faff95fd7973 independently executes a standard-Python or available-NumPy baseline from the actual source, checks counts/sums/hashes/settings, and reports numeric baseline comparisons and reproducible evidence in reproduction. Pilot must receive request_changes even if correct; final approval requires all final criteria.

Use only actually available tools, no installs or network refetch, and include own-run original input receipts. Hand off exact sasa.json only after captain approval with bound Host-validated approval evidence; report unavailable prerequisites, and stop once the required attempt envelope exists.

scientificChecks.provenance: Independent count of chain A residue identifiers in frozen public 1CRN ATOM records.

tasks.title: Synthesize independently checked approved SASA
tasks.goal: After the HARD sasa dependency is approved, read approved sasa.json and the frozen source, independently verify provenance, counts and residue sum, and deliver synthesis with summary, total_A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256 and complete executed code under the exact synthesis resultSchema in alignmentMarkdown. The result describes one fixed structure without biological function ranking.
tasks.boundary: Assigned only to the non-captain Codex member. Scientific inputs are the approved SASA artifact and frozen source; workflow context and bound review evidence are used only for contract/provenance validation. # Preregistered single-machine three-member acceptance
Real public 1CRN structure, chain A, heavy ATOM records only, alternate location blank/A, no HETATM or hydrogens, Angstrom. Exact source attachment; do not refetch. This is computational geometry, not functional or clinical evidence.
Exactly TWO tasks: sasa assigned to the SciencePAL member, synthesis assigned to the non-captain Codex member. Captain coordinates alignment and independently reviews both tasks; captain has no authoring task. Use member-scoped IDs from context, never merge the two Codex members.

Real public 1CRN structure, chain A, heavy ATOM records only, alternate location blank/A, no HETATM or hydrogens, Angstrom. Exact source attachment; do not refetch. This is computational geometry, not functional or clinical evidence.
Exactly TWO tasks: sasa assigned to the SciencePAL member, synthesis assigned to the non-captain Codex member. Captain coordinates alignment and independently reviews both tasks; captain has no authoring task. Use member-scoped IDs from context, never merge the two Codex members.
SciencePAL sasa MUST actually run Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley, probe_radius_A=1.4, radii C=1.70 N=1.55 O=1.52 S=1.80. Deliver total_A2 and residues [{residue_id:integer,area_A2:number}], n_points, atom_count, residue_count, source_sha256, method literal Shrake-Rupley, code (complete portable executed Python source) and tool_versions. Exactly TWO tasks: sasa assigned to the SciencePAL member, synthesis assigned to the non-captain Codex member. Captain coordinates alignment and independently reviews both tasks; captain has no authoring task. Use member-scoped IDs from context, never merge the two Codex members.
SciencePAL sasa MUST actually run Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley, probe_radius_A=1.4, radii C=1.70 N=1.55 O=1.52 S=1.80. Deliver total_A2 and residues [{residue_id:integer,area_A2:number}], n_points, atom_count, residue_count, source_sha256, method literal Shrake-Rupley, code (complete portable executed Python source) and tool_versions. proposals.content:
# Preregistered single-machine three-member acceptance
Real public 1CRN structure, chain A, heavy ATOM records only, alternate location blank/A, no HETATM or hydrogens, Angstrom. Exact source attachment; do not refetch. This is computational geometry, not functional or clinical evidence.
Exactly TWO tasks: sasa assigned to the SciencePAL member, synthesis assigned to the non-captain Codex member. Captain coordinates alignment and independently reviews both tasks; captain has no authoring task. Use member-scoped IDs from context, never merge the two Codex members.
SciencePAL sasa MUST actually run Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley, probe_radius_A=1.4, radii C=1.70 N=1.55 O=1.52 S=1.80. Deliver total_A2 and residues [{residue_id:integer,area_A2:number}], n_points, atom_count, residue_count, source_sha256, method literal Shrake-Rupley, code (complete portable executed Python source) and tool_versions. All values must be computed, not copied from earlier studies.
FIRST sasa attempt is a deliberately incomplete PILOT: BEFORE computing, use your actual ask-user/question tool to ask for the verification phrase. The required answer is not in these files; wait, do not invent one. This is an authorized controlled NEEDS_INPUT lifecycle test. Once an answer arrives, compute ONLY n_points=100, label exploratory, and submit. It intentionally FAILS the final acceptance requirement; reviewer must request_changes. On REWORK (when previous-sasa.json and feedback are provided), do not ask again: compute 1000 and 5000 points, report convergence total relative difference <=2% and limitation. This is planned refinement, not an accidental model mistake.
Sasa acceptance must include: correct frozen source/filter/counts; actual code and tool versions with units/radii; final n_points>=1000 AND an actually executed 5000-point comparison with <=2% total difference. Retain pilot truthfully; no fabricating success. Codex reviewer must compute an independent baseline using actual source and standard Python or available NumPy, and report numeric evidence in reproduction. For pilot, a correct 100-point output still requires changes because precision criterion is unmet.
Synthesis reads only APPROVED sasa.json and source, independently sums residues and hashes approved upstream bytes, and emits summary, total_A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256, code. Explicitly say single fixed structure, no biological function ranking. Captain independently reviews synthesis by recomputing counts/sums/hashes.
Only use available tools; no package installs or network refetch. For local Windows Python use python or py if available; do not scan unrelated paths. All public evidence must avoid user paths, tokens, personal contact details. Code should use relative input paths. Stop after actual required envelope exists.

ROLE: Captain: align and independently review, do not author sasa/synthesis
